title: Web application release
description: Readiness for releasing a web application: browsers, accessibility, performance, security headers, authentication, privacy and consent, error handling, monitoring and deployment rollback.
advisory: Engineering checklist. Accessibility conformance claims (WCAG) and privacy/consent obligations need review against the authoritative texts and applicable law.

questions.text: Does the site set non-essential cookies or trackers?
Must the site work on mobile browsers?

criteria.title: Supported browsers tested
criteria.expected: Main flows pass on the documented browser matrix (latest two versions of each).

verification.method: Automated end-to-end tests on the matrix.

task.title: Run end-to-end tests on the browser matrix
task.description: Run main flows on each supported browser.

criteria.title: Mobile layouts and touch work
criteria.expected: Main flows work at phone widths with touch input.

task.title: Test main flows on mobile widths
task.description: Check layouts and touch interaction at phone widths.

criteria.title: Automated accessibility scan clean
criteria.expected: An automated scan (e.g. axe) of main pages reports no serious or critical violations.

task.title: Add an automated accessibility scan
task.description: Scan main pages in CI and fix serious/critical findings.

criteria.title: Keyboard and screen-reader walkthrough
criteria.expected: All interactive elements are reachable by keyboard with visible focus and meaningful names.

verification.method: Manual walkthrough with keyboard and a screen reader.

task.title: Walk through with keyboard and a screen reader
task.description: Navigate every page by keyboard and screen reader; fix gaps.

criteria.title: Performance budget met
criteria.expected: Key pages meet the agreed load and interaction budgets on a mid-range device profile.

verification.method: Lab measurement (e.g. Lighthouse) in CI with the budget recorded.

task.title: Measure performance against the budget
task.description: Measure key pages in CI and record results against the budget.

criteria.title: Security headers and HTTPS
criteria.expected: HTTPS only, HSTS, a content security policy and safe cookie flags are set.

verification.method: Automated header check against the deployed environment.

task.title: Check HTTPS and security headers
task.description: Verify HTTPS, HSTS, CSP and cookie flags on the deployed site.

criteria.title: Authentication flows secure
criteria.expected: Sign-in, sign-out, session expiry, password reset and rate limiting work and are tested.

verification.method: Integration tests against a non-production identity backend.

task.title: Test authentication flows
task.description: Test sign-in, sign-out, expiry, reset and rate limiting.

criteria.title: Payments handled by a compliant provider
criteria.expected: Card data never touches the application servers; provider test-mode flows pass.

verification.method: Test-mode payment run and architecture review.

task.title: Verify payment flows in test mode
task.description: Run test-mode payments and confirm card data stays with the provider.

criteria.title: Consent before non-essential cookies
criteria.expected: No non-essential cookie or tracker loads before consent; withdrawal works. (Advisory: confirm applicable law.)

verification.method: Manual check with a fresh browser profile plus network inspection.

task.title: Verify consent gating of cookies and trackers
task.description: With a fresh profile, confirm nothing non-essential loads before consent.

criteria.title: Errors are handled and reported
criteria.expected: User-facing errors are understandable; server and client errors reach monitoring.

verification.method: Fault injection in staging and monitoring check.

task.title: Verify error handling and reporting
task.description: Inject failures in staging; confirm messages and monitoring alerts.

criteria.title: Deployment can be rolled back
criteria.expected: A previous version can be restored within the agreed time, including database migrations.

task.title: Rehearse a rollback
task.description: Deploy and roll back in staging, including migrations; record the time.
